title: Sofacy_Fysbis_Backdoor_Investigation_a7a
description: Investigate and respond to a Sofacy group compromise using their Fysbis Linux backdoor.

levels.title: Introduction
levels.content: The target network has been compromised by the Sofacy group using their Fysbis Linux backdoor. Your task is to investigate and respond to this incident.

levels.title: Get Access
levels.cloud_content: You have SSH access to the target host with the username `cyrano` and password `cyrano`. From there, you can investigate the compromised system and any connected hosts. Enter `start` to begin.
levels.local_content: You have SSH access to the target host with the username `cyrano` and password `cyrano`. From there, you can investigate the compromised system and any connected hosts. Enter `start` to begin.

levels.title: Investigate Suspicious Service
levels.content: Investigate the target host for suspicious services or processes. What is the name of the suspicious service running on the target host?
levels.solution: Check running services and look for anything unusual or unauthorized. The suspicious service is named `bkd.service`.

hints.title: First hint title
hints.content: Consider examining the system's active services to identify any anomalies.

levels.title: Determine Persistence Mechanism
levels.content: Determine how the suspicious service maintains persistence on the target host. What is the persistence mechanism used by the suspicious service?
levels.solution: Investigate systemd services and timers that might be responsible for starting the suspicious service. The persistence mechanism is a systemd timer.

hints.title: First hint title
hints.content: Explore the system's boot and startup configurations to understand how services are initiated.

levels.title: Identify Suspicious File
levels.content: Identify the file associated with the suspicious service and analyze its behavior. What is the name of the file associated with the suspicious service?
levels.solution: Look for unusual files in the home directory of the user and analyze their contents and permissions. The file associated with the suspicious service is named `lab-checkin.sh`.

hints.title: First hint title
hints.content: Search for unusual files that might be related to the suspicious service.
